case.summary: Transaction 3514948 ($111.92) was flagged for an elevated model score of 0.943 on card C09933-K2 in billing region 264. An earlier transaction, 3508487 ($116.96), occurred within 2.1 days with an identical match-flag anomaly and a model score of 0.929. While the charges superficially matched the holder's billing region and channel, holder history shows that 5 of 11 prior transactions were confirmed fraud in closed cases CC-2565, CC-2834, and CC-5521, proving the baseline identity is compromised. Additionally, card C09933-K2 has 18 confirmed fraud outcomes across 19 prior closed cases, establishing persistent unauthorized access. The activity was confirmed as account takeover fraud with 0.97 probability, leading to a card block.
